representation.name: Colony area model fitting
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > fit_colony.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
infile <- args[[1]]
outfile <- args[[2]]
diagfile <- args[[3]]

dat <- read.csv(infile, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
dat$StrainNumber <- as.character(dat$StrainNumber)
ratio_parts <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(dat$Ratio, ':', fixed = TRUE))
left <- as.numeric(ratio_parts[, 1])
right <- as.numeric(ratio_parts[, 2])

dat$p <- NA_real_
mixture <- dat$StrainNumber == '287_98'
dat$p[mixture] <- left[mixture] / (left[mixture] + right[mixture])
dat$p[dat$StrainNumber == '287'] <- 1
dat$p[dat$StrainNumber == '98'] <- 0
fitdat <- dat[!is.na(dat$p) & !is.na(dat$Area), c('DishNumber', 'StrainNumber', 'Ratio', 'Replicate', 'Area', 'p')]
fitdat$Area <- as.numeric(fitdat$Area)

models <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2), data = fitdat),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data = fitdat),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ splines::ns(p, df = 4), data = fitdat)
)
model_names <- names(models)
aics <- vapply(models, AIC, numeric(1))
best_name <- model_names[which.min(aics)]
best_model <- models[[best_name]]

obj <- function(x) {
  -as.numeric(predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(p = x)))
}
opt <- optimize(obj, interval = c(0, 1), maximum = FALSE)
opt_p <- opt$minimum
max_area <- -opt$objective

answer <- data.frame(
  best_model = best_name,
  optimum_proportion_287 = opt_p,
  predicted_max_area = max_area,
  n_rows = nrow(fitdat),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(answer, file = outfile, sep = '\t', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

diag <- data.frame(
  model = model_names,
  df = vapply(models, function(m) attr(logLik(m), 'df'), numeric(1)),
  AIC = as.numeric(aics),
  nobs = vapply(models, nobs, numeric(1)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(diag, file = diagfile, sep = '\t', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
RSCRIPT
Rscript fit_colony.R "$(inputs.input.path)" result.tsv diagnostics.tsv

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > fit_colony.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_path <- args[[1]]
result_path <- args[[2]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(splines))

d <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
required <- c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Area")
missing <- setdiff(required, names(d))
if (length(missing) > 0) stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing, collapse = ",")))

parse_p <- function(strain, ratio) {
  strain <- as.character(strain)
  ratio <- as.character(ratio)
  if (strain == "98") return(0)
  if (strain == "287") return(1)
  if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- strsplit(ratio, ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    if (length(parts) != 2) stop(paste("Bad ratio", ratio))
    nums <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts))
    if (any(is.na(nums)) || sum(nums) == 0) stop(paste("Bad numeric ratio", ratio))
    return(nums[1] / sum(nums))
  }
  return(NA_real_)
}

p <- mapply(parse_p, d$StrainNumber, d$Ratio)
analysis <- d[!is.na(p), , drop = FALSE]
analysis$p287 <- as.numeric(p[!is.na(p)])
analysis$Area <- as.numeric(analysis$Area)
analysis <- analysis[is.finite(analysis$p287) & is.finite(analysis$Area), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(analysis) < 6) stop("Too few analysis rows")

fits <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2), data = analysis),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2) + I(p287^3), data = analysis),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ ns(p287, df = 4), data = analysis)
)
aics <- vapply(fits, AIC, numeric(1))
best_name <- names(which.min(aics))[1]
best_fit <- fits[[best_name]]

pred_fun <- function(x) as.numeric(predict(best_fit, newdata = data.frame(p287 = x)))
opt <- optimize(function(x) -pred_fun(x), interval = c(0, 1), maximum = FALSE)
edge_x <- c(0, 1)
edge_y <- vapply(edge_x, pred_fun, numeric(1))
candidates <- data.frame(p287 = c(opt$minimum, edge_x), predicted_area = c(pred_fun(opt$minimum), edge_y))
best_idx <- which.max(candidates$predicted_area)
opt_p <- candidates$p287[best_idx]
max_pred <- candidates$predicted_area[best_idx]

summary_out <- data.frame(
  key = c("analysis_rows", "best_model", "best_aic", "optimal_p287", "max_predicted_area", paste0("AIC_", names(aics))),
  value = c(nrow(analysis), best_name, format(aics[[best_name]], digits = 17), format(opt_p, digits = 17), format(max_pred, digits = 17), format(aics, digits = 17)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(summary_out, file = result_path, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT

representation.name: Codex Swarm Model Fit
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analysis.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1) stop('Expected one input path')
input_path <- args[[1]]

library(splines)

dat <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
required <- c('DishNumber','StrainNumber','Ratio','Replicate','Area')
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(dat))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) stop(paste('Missing columns:', paste(missing_cols, collapse = ', ')))

dat$StrainNumber <- as.character(dat$StrainNumber)
dat$Ratio <- as.character(dat$Ratio)
dat$Area <- as.numeric(dat$Area)

curve <- dat[dat$StrainNumber %in% c('98', '287', '287_98'), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(curve) == 0) stop('No 287/98 curve rows found')

parse_mix_p <- function(ratio) {
  parts <- strsplit(ratio, ':', fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) != 2) stop(paste('Bad ratio:', ratio))
  a <- as.numeric(parts[[1]])
  b <- as.numeric(parts[[2]])
  if (!is.finite(a) || !is.finite(b) || a < 0 || b < 0 || (a + b) <= 0) stop(paste('Bad ratio:', ratio))
  a / (a + b)
}

curve$p <- NA_real_
curve$p[curve$StrainNumber == '98'] <- 0
curve$p[curve$StrainNumber == '287'] <- 1
is_mix <- curve$StrainNumber == '287_98'
curve$p[is_mix] <- vapply(curve$Ratio[is_mix], parse_mix_p, numeric(1))
curve <- curve[is.finite(curve$p) & is.finite(curve$Area), , drop = FALSE]

if (nrow(curve) < 6) stop('Too few complete rows for candidate models')
if (min(curve$p) > 0 || max(curve$p) < 1) stop('Expected observed boundary rows p=0 and p=1')

models <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2), data = curve),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data = curve),
  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ ns(p, df = 4), data = curve)
)
aics <- vapply(models, AIC, numeric(1))
best_name <- names(aics)[which.min(aics)]
best_model <- models[[best_name]]

predfun <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(p = x)))
}

lower <- min(curve$p)
upper <- max(curve$p)
breaks <- seq(lower, upper, length.out = 1001)
candidates <- c(lower, upper, unique(curve$p))
for (i in seq_len(length(breaks) - 1)) {
  lo <- breaks[[i]]
  hi <- breaks[[i + 1]]
  opt <- try(optimize(function(z) -predfun(z), interval = c(lo, hi), tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5), silent = TRUE)
  if (!inherits(opt, 'try-error') && is.finite(opt$minimum)) candidates <- c(candidates, opt$minimum)
}
vals <- vapply(candidates, predfun, numeric(1))
idx <- which.max(vals)
opt_p <- candidates[[idx]]
max_pred <- vals[[idx]]

writeLines(formatC(max_pred, digits = 15, format = 'fg', flag = '#'), 'answer.txt')

aud <- data.frame(
  field = c('n_rows','best_model','optimal_p','max_predicted_area', paste0('AIC_', names(aics))),
  value = c(as.character(nrow(curve)), best_name, formatC(opt_p, digits = 15, format = 'fg', flag = '#'), formatC(max_pred, digits = 15, format = 'fg', flag = '#'), formatC(aics, digits = 15, format = 'fg', flag = '#')),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
write.table(aud, file = 'audit.tsv', sep = '\t', quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
RSCRIPT

  natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ ns(p287, df=4), data=curve)
)

set -eu
cat > job.R <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
d <- read.csv(args[1], stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
required <- c("StrainNumber","Ratio","Area")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Missing required columns")
if (anyNA(d[required])) stop("Missing model fields")
parts <- strsplit(d[["Ratio"]], ":", fixed=TRUE)
if (any(lengths(parts) != 2L)) stop("Invalid ratio encoding")
num <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[1]), numeric(1))
den <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[2]), numeric(1))
if (any(!is.finite(num)) || any(!is.finite(den)) || any(num + den <= 0)) stop("Invalid ratio values")
d[["p287"]] <- num/(num+den)
mix <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "287_98", c("Area","p287")]
names(mix) <- c("area","p")
if (nrow(mix) != 36L) stop("Unexpected mixture row count")
if (length(unique(mix[["p"]])) != 12L) stop("Unexpected mixture frequency count")
pure287 <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "287", "Area", drop=TRUE]
pure98 <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "98", "Area", drop=TRUE]
if (length(pure287) != 3L || length(pure98) != 3L) stop("Unexpected pure endpoint counts")
complete <- rbind(mix, data.frame(area=pure98,p=0), data.frame(area=pure287,p=1))

find_optimum <- function(fit, lo, hi) {
  grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out=10001L)
  yg <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata=data.frame(p=grid)))
  local <- which(yg[2:(length(yg)-1L)] >= yg[1:(length(yg)-2L)] &
                 yg[2:(length(yg)-1L)] >= yg[3:length(yg)]) + 1L
  cand_p <- c(lo, hi)
  for (i in local) {
    left <- grid[max(1L, i-1L)]
    right <- grid[min(length(grid), i+1L)]
    z <- optimize(function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=data.frame(p=x))),
                  interval=c(left,right), maximum=TRUE, tol=1e-12)
    cand_p <- c(cand_p, z[["maximum"]])
  }
  cand_y <- vapply(cand_p, function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=data.frame(p=x))), numeric(1))
  j <- which.max(cand_y)
  c(optimal_p=cand_p[j], predicted_max=cand_y[j])
}

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope) {
  fits <- list(
    quadratic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2), data=dat),
    cubic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data=dat),
    natural_spline_df4=lm(area ~ splines::ns(p, df=4), data=dat)
  )
  nobs_vec <- vapply(fits, nobs, numeric(1))
  if (length(unique(nobs_vec)) != 1L || nobs_vec[1] != nrow(dat)) stop("Candidate models used different rows")
  aics <- vapply(fits, AIC, numeric(1))
  best <- names(fits)[which.min(aics)]
  opts <- lapply(fits, find_optimum, lo=min(dat[["p"]]), hi=max(dat[["p"]]))
  data.frame(
    scope=scope,
    model=names(fits),
    n=as.integer(nobs_vec),
    parameter_count=vapply(fits,function(x) as.integer(attr(logLik(x),"df")),integer(1)),
    aic=as.numeric(aics),
    optimal_p=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["optimal_p"]],numeric(1)),
    predicted_max=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["predicted_max"]],numeric(1)),
    best_by_min_aic=names(fits)==best,
    domain_min=min(dat[["p"]]),
    domain_max=max(dat[["p"]]),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE
  )
}

res <- rbind(fit_scope(mix,"mixtures_only"),fit_scope(complete,"mixtures_plus_pure_endpoints"))
write.table(res,file="model_results.tsv",sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE,digits=15)
chosen <- res[res[["scope"]]=="mixtures_only" & res[["best_by_min_aic"]],]
if (nrow(chosen) != 1L) stop("Best model selection failed")
writeLines(format(round(chosen[["predicted_max"]],6),scientific=FALSE,trim=TRUE,nsmall=0),con="answer.txt")

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly=TRUE)
d <- read.csv(args[1], stringsAsFactors=FALSE, check.names=FALSE)
required <- c("StrainNumber","Ratio","Area")
if (!all(required %in% names(d))) stop("Missing required columns")
if (anyNA(d[required])) stop("Missing model fields")
parts <- strsplit(d[["Ratio"]], ":", fixed=TRUE)
if (any(lengths(parts) != 2L)) stop("Invalid ratio encoding")
num <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[1]), numeric(1))
den <- vapply(parts, function(z) as.numeric(z[2]), numeric(1))
if (any(!is.finite(num)) || any(!is.finite(den)) || any(num + den <= 0)) stop("Invalid ratio values")
d[["p287"]] <- num/(num+den)
mix <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "287_98", c("Area","p287")]
names(mix) <- c("area","p")
if (nrow(mix) != 36L) stop("Unexpected mixture row count")
if (length(unique(mix[["p"]])) != 12L) stop("Unexpected mixture frequency count")
pure287 <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "287", "Area", drop=TRUE]
pure98 <- d[as.character(d[["StrainNumber"]]) == "98", "Area", drop=TRUE]
if (length(pure287) != 3L || length(pure98) != 3L) stop("Unexpected pure endpoint counts")
complete <- rbind(mix, data.frame(area=pure98,p=0), data.frame(area=pure287,p=1))

find_optimum <- function(fit, lo, hi) {
  grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out=10001L)
  yg <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata=data.frame(p=grid)))
  local <- which(yg[2:(length(yg)-1L)] >= yg[1:(length(yg)-2L)] &
                 yg[2:(length(yg)-1L)] >= yg[3:length(yg)]) + 1L
  cand_p <- c(lo, hi)
  for (i in local) {
    left <- grid[max(1L, i-1L)]
    right <- grid[min(length(grid), i+1L)]
    z <- optimize(function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=data.frame(p=x))),
                  interval=c(left,right), maximum=TRUE, tol=1e-12)
    cand_p <- c(cand_p, z[["maximum"]])
  }
  cand_y <- vapply(cand_p, function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit,newdata=data.frame(p=x))), numeric(1))
  j <- which.max(cand_y)
  c(optimal_p=cand_p[j], predicted_max=cand_y[j])
}

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope) {
  fits <- list(
    quadratic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2), data=dat),
    cubic=lm(area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data=dat),
    natural_spline_df4=lm(area ~ splines::ns(p, df=4), data=dat)
  )
  nobs_vec <- vapply(fits, nobs, numeric(1))
  if (length(unique(nobs_vec)) != 1L || nobs_vec[1] != nrow(dat)) stop("Candidate models used different rows")
  aics <- vapply(fits, AIC, numeric(1))
  best <- names(fits)[which.min(aics)]
  opts <- lapply(fits, find_optimum, lo=min(dat[["p"]]), hi=max(dat[["p"]]))
  data.frame(
    scope=scope,
    model=names(fits),
    n=as.integer(nobs_vec),
    parameter_count=vapply(fits,function(x) as.integer(attr(logLik(x),"df")),integer(1)),
    aic=as.numeric(aics),
    optimal_p=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["optimal_p"]],numeric(1)),
    predicted_max=vapply(opts,function(x)x[["predicted_max"]],numeric(1)),
    best_by_min_aic=names(fits)==best,
    domain_min=min(dat[["p"]]),
    domain_max=max(dat[["p"]]),
    stringsAsFactors=FALSE
  )
}

res <- rbind(fit_scope(mix,"mixtures_only"),fit_scope(complete,"mixtures_plus_pure_endpoints"))
write.table(res,file="model_results.tsv",sep="\t",quote=FALSE,row.names=FALSE,digits=15)
chosen <- res[res[["scope"]]=="mixtures_only" & res[["best_by_min_aic"]],]
if (nrow(chosen) != 1L) stop("Best model selection failed")
writeLines(format(round(chosen[["predicted_max"]],6),scientific=FALSE,trim=TRUE,nsmall=0),con="answer.txt")

representation.name: Swarm colony area model comparison (R)
representation.shell_command:
set -eu
Rscript - "$(inputs.input_csv.path)" <<'RSCRIPT'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1) stop("Expected exactly one CSV input path")
input_path <- args[[1]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(splines))

d <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
required <- c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Replicate", "Area")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(d))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0) stop(paste("Missing columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))

strain <- as.character(d$StrainNumber)
ratio <- as.character(d$Ratio)
area <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(d$Area)))
if (any(!is.finite(area))) stop("Area contains non-finite values")

is_mix <- strain == "287_98"
is_98 <- strain == "98"
is_287 <- strain == "287"
keep <- is_mix | is_98 | is_287
if (!any(keep)) stop("No 287_98 mixture or matching pure endpoint rows found")

p287 <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(d))
p287[is_98] <- 0
p287[is_287] <- 1

mix_idx <- which(is_mix)
parts <- strsplit(ratio[mix_idx], ":", fixed = TRUE)
if (length(parts) == 0 || any(lengths(parts) != 2)) stop("Mixture ratios are not two-component ratios")
p287[mix_idx] <- vapply(parts, function(z) {
  a <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[[1]]))
  b <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[[2]]))
  if (!is.finite(a) || !is.finite(b) || a < 0 || b < 0 || a + b <= 0) return(NA_real_)
  a / (a + b)
}, numeric(1))

if (any(!is.finite(p287[keep])) || any(p287[keep] < 0 | p287[keep] > 1)) {
  stop("Invalid strain-287 proportions")
}

fit_data <- data.frame(area = area[keep], p = p287[keep])
interior_data <- data.frame(area = area[is_mix], p = p287[is_mix])
if (nrow(fit_data) < 10 || nrow(interior_data) < 10) stop("Unexpectedly small analysis sets")

find_maximum <- function(fit, lower, upper) {
  grid <- seq(lower, upper, length.out = 20001)
  grid_pred <- as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p = grid)))
  n <- length(grid_pred)
  local_max <- which(
    (seq_len(n) == 1 | grid_pred >= c(-Inf, grid_pred[-n])) &
    (seq_len(n) == n | grid_pred >= c(grid_pred[-1], -Inf))
  )
  candidates <- lapply(local_max, function(i) {
    if (i == 1 || i == n) {
      return(c(p = grid[[i]], y = grid_pred[[i]]))
    }
    opt <- optimize(
      function(x) as.numeric(predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p = x))),
      interval = c(grid[[i - 1]], grid[[i + 1]]),
      maximum = TRUE
    )
    c(p = opt$maximum, y = opt$objective)
  })
  candidate_matrix <- do.call(rbind, candidates)
  candidate_matrix[which.max(candidate_matrix[, "y"]), , drop = FALSE]
}

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope_name, lower, upper) {
  models <- list(
    quadratic = lm(area ~ p + I(p^2), data = dat),
    cubic = lm(area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data = dat),
    natural_spline_df4 = lm(area ~ ns(p, df = 4), data = dat)
  )
  rows <- lapply(names(models), function(model_name) {
    fit <- models[[model_name]]
    sm <- summary(fit)
    mx <- find_maximum(fit, lower, upper)
    data.frame(
      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n_obs = nrow(dat),
      domain_min = lower,
      domain_max = upper,
      aic = as.numeric(AIC(fit)),
      bic = as.numeric(BIC(fit)),
      r_squared = as.numeric(sm$r.squared),
      adj_r_squared = as.numeric(sm$adj.r.squared),
      rmse = sqrt(mean(residuals(fit)^2)),
      optimal_p287 = as.numeric(mx[["p"]]),
      max_predicted_area = as.numeric(mx[["y"]]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  out <- do.call(rbind, rows)
  out$aic_rank <- rank(out$aic, ties.method = "first")
  out$selected_by_AIC <- out$aic_rank == 1
  out
}

full_lower <- min(fit_data$p)
full_upper <- max(fit_data$p)
interior_lower <- min(interior_data$p)
interior_upper <- max(interior_data$p)

full_results <- fit_scope(fit_data, "full_curve_with_pure_endpoints", full_lower, full_upper)
interior_results <- fit_scope(interior_data, "interior_mixtures_only", interior_lower, interior_upper)
results <- rbind(full_results, interior_results)
results$criterion <- "AIC_lower_is_better"
results$r_version <- paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep = ".")

write.table(
  results,
  file = "model_results.tsv",
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = "NA"
)
RSCRIPT

representation.shell_command:
set -eu
cat > analyze.R <<'RSCRIPT'
options(stringsAsFactors = FALSE, digits = 17)
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 1L) stop("Expected one CSV input path")
input_path <- args[[1L]]

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(splines))
d <- read.csv(input_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)

required <- c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Replicate", "Area")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(d))
if (length(missing_cols) > 0L) stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))

d$StrainNumber <- trimws(as.character(d$StrainNumber))
d$Ratio <- trimws(as.character(d$Ratio))
d$Replicate <- trimws(as.character(d$Replicate))
d$Area <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(d$Area)))
if (any(!is.finite(d$Area))) stop("Area contains non-finite values")

d$p287 <- NA_real_
is_mix <- d$StrainNumber == "287_98"
mix_parts <- strsplit(d$Ratio[is_mix], ":", fixed = TRUE)
if (length(mix_parts) > 0L) {
  if (any(lengths(mix_parts) != 2L)) stop("Mixture ratios must have exactly two components")
  a <- vapply(mix_parts, function(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[[1L]])), numeric(1))
  b <- vapply(mix_parts, function(z) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(z[[2L]])), numeric(1))
  if (any(!is.finite(a)) || any(!is.finite(b)) || any(a < 0) || any(b < 0) || any(a + b <= 0)) {
    stop("Invalid mixture ratio")
  }
  d$p287[is_mix] <- a / (a + b)
}
d$p287[d$StrainNumber == "98" & !is_mix] <- 0
d$p287[d$StrainNumber == "287" & !is_mix] <- 1

component_system <- d$StrainNumber %in% c("98", "287", "287_98")
if (any(d$StrainNumber == "1")) {
  # Strain 1 is an unrelated pure control and is not part of the 287_98 curve.
}
if (any(!component_system & d$StrainNumber != "1")) {
  stop("Unexpected strain labels outside the 287_98 system")
}

primary <- d[component_system & is.finite(d$Area) & is.finite(d$p287), , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(primary) != 45L) stop(paste("Unexpected primary row count:", nrow(primary)))
if (length(unique(primary$Replicate)) != 3L) stop("Unexpected replicate structure")
if (any(primary$p287 < 0 | primary$p287 > 1)) stop("Proportion outside [0,1]")
primary$p287 <- pmin(pmax(primary$p287, 0), 1)
interior <- primary[primary$StrainNumber == "287_98", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(interior) != 36L) stop(paste("Unexpected interior row count:", nrow(interior)))

make_optimum <- function(fit, dat, ngrid = 20001L) {
  domain <- range(dat$p287)
  grid <- seq(domain[[1L]], domain[[2L]], length.out = ngrid)
  grid_pred <- as.numeric(stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p287 = grid)))
  if (any(!is.finite(grid_pred))) stop("Non-finite grid prediction")
  if (ngrid >= 3L) {
    local_idx <- which(
      grid_pred[2:(ngrid - 1L)] >= grid_pred[1:(ngrid - 2L)] &
      grid_pred[2:(ngrid - 1L)] >= grid_pred[3:ngrid]
    ) + 1L
  } else {
    local_idx <- integer(0L)
  }
  candidate_idx <- unique(c(1L, ngrid, local_idx))
  refine_one <- function(i) {
    if (i == 1L || i == ngrid) {
      return(c(p = grid[[i]], predicted_area = grid_pred[[i]]))
    }
    refined <- stats::optimize(
      f = function(x) as.numeric(stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p287 = x))),
      interval = c(grid[[i - 1L]], grid[[i + 1L]]),
      maximum = TRUE
    )
    c(p = refined$maximum, predicted_area = refined$objective)
  }
  candidates <- do.call(rbind, lapply(candidate_idx, refine_one))
  best <- candidates[which.max(candidates[, "predicted_area"]), , drop = FALSE]
  c(
    optimum_frequency = as.numeric(best[["p"]]),
    predicted_area = as.numeric(best[["predicted_area"]]),
    domain_min = domain[[1L]],
    domain_max = domain[[2L]]
  )
}

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope_name) {
  formulas <- list(
    quadratic = Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2),
    cubic = Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2) + I(p287^3),
    natural_spline_df4 = Area ~ splines::ns(p287, df = 4)
  )
  comparison_rows <- list()
  optimum_rows <- list()
  fits <- list()
  for (model_name in names(formulas)) {
    fit <- stats::lm(formulas[[model_name]], data = dat)
    fits[[model_name]] <- fit
    fit_summary <- summary(fit)
    opt <- make_optimum(fit, dat)
    comparison_rows[[model_name]] <- data.frame(
      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n = nobs(fit),
      parameters = length(stats::coef(fit)),
      aic = as.numeric(stats::AIC(fit)),
      bic = as.numeric(stats::BIC(fit)),
      r_squared = as.numeric(fit_summary$r.squared),
      adjusted_r_squared = as.numeric(fit_summary$adj.r.squared),
      rss = as.numeric(deviance(fit)),
      optimum_frequency = opt[["optimum_frequency"]],
      predicted_area = opt[["predicted_area"]],
      domain_min = opt[["domain_min"]],
      domain_max = opt[["domain_max"]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    optimum_rows[[model_name]] <- data.frame(
      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n = nobs(fit),
      aic = as.numeric(stats::AIC(fit)),
      optimum_frequency = opt[["optimum_frequency"]],
      predicted_area = opt[["predicted_area"]],
      domain_min = opt[["domain_min"]],
      domain_max = opt[["domain_max"]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  comparison <- do.call(rbind, comparison_rows)
  optimums <- do.call(rbind, optimum_rows)
  comparison$selected_by_aic <- comparison$model == comparison$model[which.min(comparison$aic)]
  optimums$selected_by_aic <- optimums$model == optimums$model[which.min(optimums$aic)]
  list(comparison = comparison, optimums = optimums, fits = fits)
}

primary_fit <- fit_scope(primary, "primary_full_boundaries")
interior_fit <- fit_scope(interior, "interior_mixtures_only")
comparison <- rbind(primary_fit$comparison, interior_fit$comparison)
optimums <- rbind(primary_fit$optimums, interior_fit$optimums)

primary_selected <- primary_fit$optimums[which.min(primary_fit$optimums$aic), , drop = FALSE]
primary_selected$selection_metric <- "minimum_AIC"
primary_selected$selection_scope <- "primary_full_boundaries"
primary_selected <- primary_selected[, c(
  "selection_scope", "selection_metric", "model", "n", "aic",
  "optimum_frequency", "predicted_area", "domain_min", "domain_max"
), drop = FALSE]

utils::write.table(
  comparison,
  file = "model_comparison.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)
utils::write.table(
  optimums,
  file = "model_optima.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)
utils::write.table(
  primary_selected,
  file = "optimal_prediction.tsv",
  sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE
)

make_optimum <- function(fit, dat, ngrid = 20001L) {
  domain <- range(dat$p287)
  grid <- seq(domain[[1L]], domain[[2L]], length.out = ngrid)
  grid_pred <- as.numeric(stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p287 = grid)))
  if (any(!is.finite(grid_pred))) stop("Non-finite grid prediction")
  if (ngrid >= 3L) {
    local_idx <- which(
      grid_pred[2:(ngrid - 1L)] >= grid_pred[1:(ngrid - 2L)] &
      grid_pred[2:(ngrid - 1L)] >= grid_pred[3:ngrid]
    ) + 1L
  } else {
    local_idx <- integer(0L)
  }
  candidate_idx <- unique(c(1L, ngrid, local_idx))
  refine_one <- function(i) {
    if (i == 1L || i == ngrid) {
      return(c(p = grid[[i]], predicted_area = grid_pred[[i]]))
    }
    refined <- stats::optimize(
      f = function(x) as.numeric(stats::predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p287 = x))),
      interval = c(grid[[i - 1L]], grid[[i + 1L]]),
      maximum = TRUE
    )
    c(p = refined$maximum, predicted_area = refined$objective)
  }
  candidates <- do.call(rbind, lapply(candidate_idx, refine_one))
  best <- candidates[which.max(candidates[, "predicted_area"]), , drop = FALSE]
  c(
    optimum_frequency = as.numeric(best[["p"]]),
    predicted_area = as.numeric(best[["predicted_area"]]),
    domain_min = domain[[1L]],
    domain_max = domain[[2L]]
  )
}

fit_scope <- function(dat, scope_name) {
  formulas <- list(
    quadratic = Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2),
    cubic = Area ~ p287 + I(p287^2) + I(p287^3),
    natural_spline_df4 = Area ~ splines::ns(p287, df = 4)
  )
  comparison_rows <- list()
  optimum_rows <- list()
  fits <- list()
  for (model_name in names(formulas)) {
    fit <- stats::lm(formulas[[model_name]], data = dat)
    fits[[model_name]] <- fit
    fit_summary <- summary(fit)
    opt <- make_optimum(fit, dat)
    comparison_rows[[model_name]] <- data.frame(
      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n = nobs(fit),
      parameters = length(stats::coef(fit)),
      aic = as.numeric(stats::AIC(fit)),
      bic = as.numeric(stats::BIC(fit)),
      r_squared = as.numeric(fit_summary$r.squared),
      adjusted_r_squared = as.numeric(fit_summary$adj.r.squared),
      rss = as.numeric(deviance(fit)),
      optimum_frequency = opt[["optimum_frequency"]],
      predicted_area = opt[["predicted_area"]],
      domain_min = opt[["domain_min"]],
      domain_max = opt[["domain_max"]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    optimum_rows[[model_name]] <- data.frame(
      scope = scope_name,
      model = model_name,
      n = nobs(fit),
      aic = as.numeric(stats::AIC(fit)),
      optimum_frequency = opt[["optimum_frequency"]],
      predicted_area = opt[["predicted_area"]],
      domain_min = opt[["domain_min"]],
      domain_max = opt[["domain_max"]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  comparison <- do.call(rbind, comparison_rows)
  optimums <- do.call(rbind, optimum_rows)
  comparison$selected_by_aic <- comparison$model == comparison$model[which.min(comparison$aic)]
  optimums$selected_by_aic <- optimums$model == optimums$model[which.min(optimums$aic)]
  list(comparison = comparison, optimums = optimums, fits = fits)
}

d <- read.csv(\"inputs/Swarm_2.csv\", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
m <- d[d"'$StrainNumber == "287_98", ]
parts <- strsplit(m$Ratio, ":", fixed=TRUE)
m$freq287 <- vapply(parts, function(p) {v <- as.numeric(p); v[1]/sum(v)}, numeric(1))
fits <- list(
 quadratic = lm(Area ~ freq287 + I(freq287''^2), data=m),
 cubic = lm(Area ~ freq287 + I(freq287''^2) + I(freq287''^3), data=m),
 natural_spline_df4 = lm(Area ~ splines::ns(freq287, df=4), data=m)
)
score <- sapply(fits, AIC)
best <- fits[[names(which.min(score))]]
lo <- min(m$freq287); hi <- max(m$freq287)
g <- seq(lo, hi, length.out=200001)
p <- as.numeric(predict(best, newdata=data.frame(freq287=g)))
ix <- which.max(p)
# Refine around the best grid point, and also check the full interval with optimize.
a <- max(lo, g[max(1, ix-1)]); b <- min(hi, g[min(length(g), ix+1)])
o <- optimize(function(x) as.numeric(predict(best, newdata=data.frame(freq287=x))), c(a,b), maximum=TRUE, tol=1e-14)
cat("best=", names(which.min(score)), "'"\\n\", sep=\"\")
cat(\"domain=\", format(lo, digits=17), \",\", format(hi, digits=17), \"\\n\", sep=\"\")
cat(\"grid_max=\", format(g[ix], digits=17), \",\", format(p[ix], digits=17), \"\\n\", sep=\"\")
cat(\"optimum_frequency=\", format(o"'$maximum, digits=17), "'"\\n\", sep=\"\")
cat(\"predicted_area=\", format(o"'$objective, digits=17), "'"\\n\", sep=\"\")
print(cbind(AIC=score, R2=sapply(fits, function(f) summary(f)"'$r.squared)))
'"'"

# galaxy-cli

CLI harness for the [Galaxy](https://galaxyproject.org/) bioinformatics platform.
Wraps Galaxy's REST API to provide full command-line and REPL access to histories,
datasets, tools, workflows, jobs, and libraries.

This package was initially generated with `cli-anything` and then refined into
the standalone `galaxy-cli` package.

## Prerequisites

- **Python 3.9+**
- **A running Galaxy server** — this CLI connects to Galaxy via its REST API.
  - Public: https://usegalaxy.org, https://usegalaxy.eu, https://usegalaxy.org.au
  - Local: Follow [Galaxy installation docs](https://docs.galaxyproject.org/)
- **Galaxy API key** — obtain from your Galaxy instance at `<url>/user/api_key`

## Installation

Install from PyPI with `uv` or `pip`:

```bash
uv tool install galaxy-cli
```

```bash
python3 -m pip install galaxy-cli
```

For local development from this repository:

```bash
cd agent-harness
python3 -m pip install .
```

Verify installation:

```bash
which galaxy-cli

# galaxy-cli

Use this skill when the task requires Galaxy operations through `galaxy-cli`.
Keep token use low: read this file once, then use `galaxy-cli <command> --help`
only for the specific command you are about to run.

## Token-Cheap Defaults

`galaxy-cli` is agent-first. The default path is:

1. Submit each tool with `galaxy-cli tool run ... --inputs-json FILE`.
2. Let `tool run` wait. Do not add `--no-wait` unless the task explicitly asks
   for asynchronous submission.
3. Use the returned `outputs` array for output IDs, state, datatype, and size.
4. Do not call `job show`, `dataset show`, `collection show`, `dataset list`,
   or `collection list` for routine verification.
5. Do not call `job show --logs` unless debugging a failed job.
6. Do not call `tool show` when task files already provide exact tool IDs and
   parameter JSON.

cat > analysis.R <<'EOF'

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(splines))

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
if (length(args) != 2) {
  stop("expected input csv and output csv paths")
}
in_path <- args[1]
out_path <- args[2]

d <- read.csv(in_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
if (!all(c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Area") %in% names(d))) {
  stop("required columns not found")
}

d <- d[d$StrainNumber == "287_98", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(d) != 36) {
  stop(sprintf("expected 36 mixture rows, found %d", nrow(d)))
}

parts <- strsplit(as.character(d$Ratio), ":", fixed = TRUE)
d$p <- vapply(parts, function(z) {
  a <- as.numeric(z[1])
  b <- as.numeric(z[2])
  a / (a + b)
}, numeric(1))

if (any(!is.finite(d$p)) || any(d$p <= 0) || any(d$p >= 1)) {
  stop("invalid interior mixture proportions")
}

fit_models <- list(
  quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2), data = d),
  cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data = d),
  natural_spline = lm(Area ~ ns(p, df = 4), data = d)
)

pred_at <- function(fit, x) {
  predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p = x))
}

global_max <- function(fit, lower, upper) {
  grid <- seq(lower, upper, length.out = 5001)
  vals <- pred_at(fit, grid)
  i <- which.max(vals)

  left <- grid[max(1L, i - 2L)]
  right <- grid[min(length(grid), i + 2L)]
  local <- optimize(function(x) pred_at(fit, x), interval = c(left, right),
                    maximum = TRUE, tol = 1e-10)

  full <- optimize(function(x) pred_at(fit, x), interval = c(lower, upper),
                   maximum = TRUE, tol = 1e-10)

  if (full$objective >= local$objective) {
    full
  } else {
    local
  }
}

lower <- min(d$p)
upper <- max(d$p)
rows <- list()

for (nm in names(fit_models)) {
  fit <- fit_models[[nm]]
  opt <- global_max(fit, lower, upper)
  aic <- AIC(fit)
  bic <- BIC(fit)
  edf <- as.numeric(extractAIC(fit)[1])
  adj_r2 <- summary(fit)$adj.r.squared

  rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(
    model = nm,
    edf = edf,
    n = nrow(d),
    aic = as.numeric(aic),
    bic = as.numeric(bic),
    adj_r2 = adj_r2,
    optimum_p = opt$maximum,
    max_area = opt$objective,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

summary_df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
write.csv(summary_df, file = out_path, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

make_prop <- function(ratio) {
  z <- strsplit(as.character(ratio), ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  a <- as.numeric(z[1]); b <- as.numeric(z[2])
  a / (a + b)
}

mixtures <- d0[d0$StrainNumber == "287_98", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(mixtures) != 36) stop("expected 36 mixture rows")
mixtures$p <- vapply(mixtures$Ratio, make_prop, numeric(1))

pure_287 <- d0[d0$StrainNumber == "287", , drop = FALSE]
pure_98$p <- 0
pure_287$p <- 1
full_raw <- rbind(mixtures[, c("p", "Area")], pure_98[, c("p", "Area")], pure_287[, c("p", "Area")])

aggregate_mean <- function(x) {
  aggregate(Area ~ p, data = x, FUN = mean)
}

interior_raw <- mixtures[, c("p", "Area")]
interior_mean <- aggregate_mean(interior_raw)
full_mean <- aggregate_mean(full_raw)

datasets <- list(
  interior_raw = interior_raw,
  interior_mean = interior_mean,
  full_raw = full_raw,
  full_mean = full_mean
)

fit_for_data <- function(dat) {
  list(
    quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2), data = dat),
    cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data = dat),
    natural_spline = lm(Area ~ ns(p, df = 4), data = dat)
  )
}

pred_at <- function(fit, x) predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(p = x))

max_on_interval <- function(fit, lower, upper) {
  grid <- seq(lower, upper, length.out = 5001)
  vals <- pred_at(fit, grid)
  i <- which.max(vals)
  left <- grid[max(1L, i - 2L)]
  right <- grid[min(length(grid), i + 2L)]
  local <- optimize(function(x) pred_at(fit, x), interval = c(left, right),
                    maximum = TRUE, tol = 1e-10)
  full <- optimize(function(x) pred_at(fit, x), interval = c(lower, upper),
                   maximum = TRUE, tol = 1e-10)
  if (full$objective >= local$objective) full else local
}

rows <- list()
for (scope_name in names(datasets)) {
  dat <- datasets[[scope_name]]
  models <- fit_for_data(dat)
  observed_lower <- min(dat$p)
  observed_upper <- max(dat$p)

  for (model_name in names(models)) {
    fit <- models[[model_name]]
    observed_opt <- max_on_interval(fit, observed_lower, observed_upper)
    unit_opt <- max_on_interval(fit, 0, 1)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1L]] <- data.frame(

      model = model_name,
      n = nrow(dat),
      edf = as.numeric(extractAIC(fit)[1]),
      aic = as.numeric(AIC(fit)),
      bic = as.numeric(BIC(fit)),
      adj_r2 = summary(fit)$adj.r.squared,

      observed_upper = observed_upper,

      optimum_p_unit_range = unit_opt$maximum,
      max_area_unit_range = unit_opt$objective,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
}

summary_df <- do.call(rbind, rows)
write.csv(summary_df, file = out_path, row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

make_scope <- function(dat, lo, hi) {

      AIC = aic,

      adjR2 = adjr2,
      opt_p = grid[[idx]],
      opt_pred = pred[[idx]],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }

parse_p <- function(s) {
  parts <- strsplit(s, ":", fixed=TRUE)[[1]]
  if (length(parts) != 2L) return(NA_real_)
  vals <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts))
  if (anyNA(vals) || any(vals < 0) || sum(vals) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  vals[[1]] / sum(vals)
}

make_scope <- function(dat, lo, hi) {
  fit_models <- list(
    quadratic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2), data=dat),
    cubic = lm(Area ~ p + I(p^2) + I(p^3), data=dat),
    spline = lm(Area ~ ns(p, df=4), data=dat)
  )
  rows <- list()
  for (model_name in names(fit_models)) {
    m <- fit_models[[model_name]]
    n <- length(residuals(m))
    k <- length(coef(m))
    rss <- sum(residuals(m)^2)
    sigma <- summary(m)$sigma
    aic <- AIC(m)
    bic <- BIC(m)
    adjr2 <- summary(m)$adj.r.squared
    grid <- seq(lo, hi, length.out=20001L)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Compare quadratic / cubic / natural-spline regression models on the same x,y.

For questions like "What is the maximum predicted y at the optimal x according
to the BEST-fitting model among quadratic, cubic and natural spline?":

- Fit `lm(y ~ poly(x, 2, raw = TRUE))`
- Fit `lm(y ~ poly(x, 3, raw = TRUE))`
- Fit `lm(y ~ ns(x, df = K))`     (default K = 4)

together with its 95% confidence interval (predict.lm interval='confidence').

since they can disagree with R^2 when complexity differs.

All R work runs via Rscript so `splines::ns()` matches what canonical R
notebooks compute. Python `patsy.cr()` does NOT match — see

r_script = '''
# Read data
d <- read.csv("input.csv", stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

# Filter: exclude strain 1 (not part of 287/98 system)
d <- d[d$StrainNumber != 1, ]

# Compute proportion of strain 287
# For pure strains: 287 -> 1, 98 -> 0
# For mixtures (287_98): parse Ratio like "1:3" -> 1/(1+3)
compute_prop <- function(strain, ratio) {
  if (strain == 287) return(1.0)
  if (strain == 98) return(0.0)
  # mixture 287_98
  parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio, ":")[[1]])
  return(parts[1] / (parts[1] + parts[2]))
}

d$Proportion <- mapply(compute_prop, d$StrainNumber, d$Ratio)

# Fit models
m2 <- lm(Area ~ poly(Proportion, 2, raw=TRUE), data=d)
m3 <- lm(Area ~ poly(Proportion, 3, raw=TRUE), data=d)

  Cubic = m3,
  NaturalSpline = mns
)

    predict(best_model, newdata=data.frame(Proportion=x))

cat("AIC_Cubic:", aics["Cubic"], "\\n", sep="")
cat("AIC_NaturalSpline:", aics["NaturalSpline"], "\\n", sep="")

import base64

r_script = '''#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_file <- args[1]
output_file <- args[2]

library(splines)

dat <- read.csv(input_file)

compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio_str) {
  if (strain == "287") return(1.0)
  if (strain == "98") return(0.0)
  if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio_str, ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / sum(parts))
  }
  return(NA)
}

dat$Proportion <- mapply(compute_proportion, dat$StrainNumber, dat$Ratio)
dat_sub <- subset(dat, !is.na(Proportion))
cat("Data rows after filtering:", nrow(dat_sub), "\\n")
cat("Proportion range:", range(dat_sub$Proportion), "\\n")

m_quad <- lm(Area ~ Proportion + I(Proportion^2), data = dat_sub)
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ Proportion + I(Proportion^2) + I(Proportion^3), data = dat_sub)
m_spline <- lm(Area ~ ns(Proportion, df = 4), data = dat_sub)

aic_quad <- AIC(m_quad)
aic_cubic <- AIC(m_cubic)
aic_spline <- AIC(m_spline)

cat("AIC Quadratic:", aic_quad, "\\n")
cat("AIC Cubic:", aic_cubic, "\\n")
cat("AIC Spline:", aic_spline, "\\n")

aics <- c(Quadratic = aic_quad, Cubic = aic_cubic, Spline = aic_spline)
best_model_name <- names(which.min(aics))
cat("Best model:", best_model_name, "\\n")

best_model <- switch(best_model_name,
  Quadratic = m_quad,
  Cubic = m_cubic,
  Spline = m_spline
)

obj_fun <- function(p) {
  newdat <- data.frame(Proportion = p)
  predict(best_model, newdata = newdat)
}

opt <- optimize(obj_fun, interval = c(0, 1), maximum = TRUE)
cat("Optimal proportion:", opt$maximum, "\\n")
cat("Max predicted area:", opt$objective, "\\n")

out <- data.frame(
  BestModel = best_model_name,
  AIC_Quadratic = aic_quad,
  AIC_Cubic = aic_cubic,
  AIC_Spline = aic_spline,
  OptimalProportion = opt$maximum,
  MaxPredictedArea = opt$objective
)

write.csv(out, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Done.\\n")
'''

script_b64 = base64.b64encode(r_script.encode()).decode()
print(script_b64)

#!/usr/bin/env Rscript
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
input_file <- args[1]
output_file <- args[2]

library(splines)

dat <- read.csv(input_file)

compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio_str) {
  if (strain == "287") return(1.0)
  if (strain == "98") return(0.0)
  if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio_str, ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / sum(parts))
  }
  return(NA)
}

dat$Proportion <- mapply(compute_proportion, dat$StrainNumber, dat$Ratio)
dat_sub <- subset(dat, !is.na(Proportion))
cat("Data rows after filtering:", nrow(dat_sub), "\n")
cat("Proportion range:", range(dat_sub$Proportion), "\n")

m_quad <- lm(Area ~ Proportion + I(Proportion^2), data = dat_sub)
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ Proportion + I(Proportion^2) + I(Proportion^3), data = dat_sub)
m_spline <- lm(Area ~ ns(Proportion, df = 4), data = dat_sub)

aic_quad <- AIC(m_quad)
aic_cubic <- AIC(m_cubic)
aic_spline <- AIC(m_spline)

cat("AIC Quadratic:", aic_quad, "\n")
cat("AIC Cubic:", aic_cubic, "\n")
cat("AIC Spline:", aic_spline, "\n")

aics <- c(Quadratic = aic_quad, Cubic = aic_cubic, Spline = aic_spline)
best_model_name <- names(which.min(aics))
cat("Best model:", best_model_name, "\n")

best_model <- switch(best_model_name,
  Quadratic = m_quad,
  Cubic = m_cubic,
  Spline = m_spline
)

obj_fun <- function(p) {
  newdat <- data.frame(Proportion = p)
  predict(best_model, newdata = newdat)
}

opt <- optimize(obj_fun, interval = c(0, 1), maximum = TRUE)
cat("Optimal proportion:", opt$maximum, "\n")
cat("Max predicted area:", opt$objective, "\n")

out <- data.frame(
  BestModel = best_model_name,
  AIC_Quadratic = aic_quad,
  AIC_Cubic = aic_cubic,
  AIC_Spline = aic_spline,
  OptimalProportion = opt$maximum,
  MaxPredictedArea = opt$objective
)

write.csv(out, output_file, row.names = FALSE)
cat("Done.\n")
ENDOFSCRIPT

  if (strain == "287" && ratio == "1:0") return(1.0)
  if (strain == "98" && ratio == "1:0") return(0.0)

  parts <- strsplit(as.character(ratio), ":")[[1]]
  a <- as.numeric(parts[1])
  b <- as.numeric(parts[2])
  return(a / (a + b))
}

aic_spline <- AIC(m_spline)

history_id = "bbd44e69cb8906b53956f430055cf836"
dataset_id = "f9cad7b01a472135cc8416a74d74282c"

# Full R analysis UDT using $(inputs.input_csv.path) syntax
representation = {
    "class": "GalaxyUserTool",
    "id": "colony-area-model-fit-final",
    "name": "Colony Area Model Fit Final",
    "version": "1.0.0",
    "container": "quay.io/biocontainers/r-base:4.3.3",
    "shell_command": """set -eu

cat > model_fitting.R << 'REOF'
args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
csv_path <- args[1]
data <- read.csv(csv_path)

# Exclude Strain 1 (unrelated strain)
data <- subset(data, StrainNumber != 1)

# Compute proportion of strain 287
compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio) {
  if (strain == "287" && ratio == "1:0") return(1.0)
  if (strain == "98" && ratio == "1:0") return(0.0)
  parts <- strsplit(as.character(ratio), ":")[[1]]
  a <- as.numeric(parts[1])
  b <- as.numeric(parts[2])
  return(a / (a + b))
}

data$Prop287 <- mapply(compute_proportion, data$StrainNumber, data$Ratio)

library(splines)

# Quadratic model
m_quad <- lm(Area ~ Prop287 + I(Prop287^2), data = data)

# Cubic model
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ Prop287 + I(Prop287^2) + I(Prop287^3), data = data)

# Natural spline df=4
m_spline <- lm(Area ~ ns(Prop287, df = 4), data = data)

# Compare by AIC
aics <- c(quadratic = AIC(m_quad), cubic = AIC(m_cubic), spline = AIC(m_spline))
best_name <- names(which.min(aics))
best_model <- switch(best_name,
  quadratic = m_quad,
  cubic = m_cubic,
  spline = m_spline
)

# Predict over fine grid
grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 10001)
newdata <- data.frame(Prop287 = grid)
pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = newdata)

max_idx <- which.max(pred)
optimal_freq <- grid[max_idx]
max_area <- pred[max_idx]

# Output
sink("results.txt")
cat("Best model:", best_name, "\\n\\n")
cat("AIC values:\\n")
for (m in names(aics)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %.4f\\n", m, aics[m]))
}
cat("\\n")
cat(sprintf("Optimal frequency: %.6f\\n", optimal_freq))
cat(sprintf("Max predicted area: %.6f\\n", max_area))
sink()
REOF

Rscript model_fitting.R "$(inputs.input_csv.path)"
""",
    "inputs": [
        {"name": "input_csv", "type": "data", "format": ["csv"]}
    ],
    "outputs": [
        {"name": "results", "type": "data", "format": "txt", "from_work_dir": "results.txt"}
    ]
}

print("Creating final UDT...")

print(f"Tool UUID: {created['uuid']}")

submitted = gi.tools.run_tool(
    history_id=history_id,
    tool_uuid=created["uuid"],
    tool_inputs={"input_csv": {"src": "hda", "id": dataset_id}}
)
job_id = submitted['jobs'][0]['id']
print(f"Job ID: {job_id}")

result = gi.jobs.wait_for_job(job_id, maxwait=600)
job_info = gi.jobs.show_job(job_id, full_details=True)

if result['state'] == 'ok':

        content = gi.datasets.download_dataset(out_info['id'])
        text = content.decode('utf-8') if isinstance(content, bytes) else content
        print(f"\n=== Results ===\n{text}")
        
        # Extract answer
        for line in text.split('\n'):
            if 'Max predicted area' in line:
                area = line.split(':')[-1].strip()
                print(f"\nANSWER (max area): {area}")
                # Write to answer file
                os.makedirs("/workspace/codex_output", exist_ok=True)
                with open("/workspace/codex_output/answer.txt", "w") as f:
                    f.write(area + '\n')
            if 'Best model' in line:
                print(f"Best: {line.strip()}")
            if 'Optimal frequency' in line:

parameters.content:
# Read data
d <- read.csv("inputs/Swarm_2.csv", sep=",", header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
cat("Columns:", paste(names(d), collapse=", "), "\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(d), "\n")

# Inspect unique strains and ratios
cat("\nUnique StrainNumber:", unique(d$StrainNumber), "\n")
cat("Unique Ratio:", unique(d$Ratio), "\n")

# Compute proportion of strain 287
# For pure strains:
#   StrainNumber 287, Ratio 1:0 -> proportion 287 = 1.0
#   StrainNumber 98, Ratio 1:0  -> proportion 287 = 0.0
#   StrainNumber 1 is a different strain -> exclude
# For mixtures (StrainNumber 287_98):
#   Ratio "X:Y" means 287:98, so proportion 287 = X/(X+Y)

compute_proportion <- function(strain, ratio_str) {
  if (strain == 287 && ratio_str == "1:0") {
    return(1.0)  # pure 287
  } else if (strain == 98 && ratio_str == "1:0") {
    return(0.0)  # pure 98
  } else if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratio_str, ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / (parts[1] + parts[2]))
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

d$prop287 <- mapply(compute_proportion, d$StrainNumber, d$Ratio)
cat("\nRows before filtering:", nrow(d), "\n")
d <- d[!is.na(d$prop287), ]
cat("Rows after filtering (287/98 system only):", nrow(d), "\n")

# Show data summary
cat("\nData summary:\n")
print(d[, c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "Replicate", "Area", "prop287")])

# Fit models
library(splines)

m_quad <- lm(Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2), data = d)
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2) + I(prop287^3), data = d)
m_ns <- lm(Area ~ ns(prop287, df = 4), data = d)

cat("\n===== Model summaries =====\n")
cat("\n--- Quadratic ---\n")
print(summary(m_quad))
cat("\n--- Cubic ---\n")
print(summary(m_cubic))
cat("\n--- Natural spline (df=4) ---\n")
print(summary(m_ns))

# Compare models using AIC and adjusted R²
cat("\n===== Model comparison =====\n")
cat("\nAIC:\n")
cat("  Quadratic:", AIC(m_quad), "\n")
cat("  Cubic:", AIC(m_cubic), "\n")
cat("  Natural spline:", AIC(m_ns), "\n")

cat("\nAdjusted R-squared:\n")
cat("  Quadratic:", summary(m_quad)$adj.r.squared, "\n")
cat("  Cubic:", summary(m_cubic)$adj.r.squared, "\n")
cat("  Natural spline:", summary(m_ns)$adj.r.squared, "\n")

cat("\nResidual standard error:\n")
cat("  Quadratic:", summary(m_quad)$sigma, "\n")
cat("  Cubic:", summary(m_cubic)$sigma, "\n")
cat("  Natural spline:", summary(m_ns)$sigma, "\n")

# Identify best model by lowest AIC
models <- list(quad = m_quad, cubic = m_cubic, ns = m_ns)
aic_vals <- sapply(models, AIC)
best_name <- names(which.min(aic_vals))
best_model <- models[[best_name]]
cat("\nBest model by AIC:", best_name, "\n")

# Also check by adj R²
adjr2_vals <- sapply(models, function(m) summary(m)$adj.r.squared)
cat("Best model by adj R²:", names(which.max(adjr2_vals)), "\n")

# Find optimum within [0, 1] for the best model
# Grid search on fine grid
grid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 10001)
if (best_name == "quad") {
  pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
} else if (best_name == "cubic") {
  pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
} else {
  pred <- predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
}

opt_idx <- which.max(pred)
opt_prop <- grid[opt_idx]
opt_area <- pred[opt_idx]

cat("\n===== Optimum for best model (", best_name, ") =====\n", sep="")
cat("Optimal proportion of strain 287:", opt_prop, "\n")
cat("Maximum predicted colony area:", opt_area, "\n")

# Also compute optimum for all models for reference
cat("\n===== Optima for all models =====\n")
for (mname in c("quad", "cubic", "ns")) {
  m <- models[[mname]]
  pred_all <- predict(m, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = grid))
  idx <- which.max(pred_all)
  cat(mname, "- optimal prop:", grid[idx], "- max area:", pred_all[idx], "\n")
}

# Plot
png("fit_plot.png", width=800, height=600)
plot(d$prop287, d$Area, pch=19, col=rgb(0,0,0,0.6),
     xlab="Proportion of strain 287", ylab="Colony Area",
     main="Model fits for colony area vs. proportion of strain 287")
lines(grid, predict(m_quad, newdata=data.frame(prop287=grid)), col="blue", lwd=2)
lines(grid, predict(m_cubic, newdata=data.frame(prop287=grid)), col="red", lwd=2, lty=2)
lines(grid, predict(m_ns, newdata=data.frame(prop287=grid)), col="darkgreen", lwd=2, lty=3)
legend("topleft", legend=c("Quadratic","Cubic","Natural spline (df=4)"),
       col=c("blue","red","darkgreen"), lty=c(1,2,3), lwd=2)
dev.off()
cat("\nPlot saved to fit_plot.png\n")

parameters.content:
# Read data
dat <- read.csv("inputs/Swarm_2.csv", sep = ",", header = TRUE)
cat("Raw data rows:", nrow(dat), "\n")

# Inspect StrainNumber and Ratio values
cat("\nUnique StrainNumber values:\n")
print(unique(dat$StrainNumber))
cat("\nRatio by StrainNumber:\n")
print(table(dat$StrainNumber, dat$Ratio))

# Build proportion of strain 287
# For mixtures 287_98, Ratio is "X:Y" meaning 287:98
# proportion of 287 = X/(X+Y)
# For pure 287 (StrainNumber=287, Ratio=1:0) -> proportion = 1
# For pure 98 (StrainNumber=98, Ratio=1:0) -> proportion = 0
# For pure 1 -> exclude

dat$prop287 <- NA

for (i in 1:nrow(dat)) {
  sn <- as.character(dat$StrainNumber[i])
  rat <- as.character(dat$Ratio[i])

  if (sn == "287" && rat == "1:0") {
    dat$prop287[i] <- 1.0
  } else if (sn == "98" && rat == "1:0") {
    dat$prop287[i] <- 0.0
  } else if (sn == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(rat, ":")[[1]])
    dat$prop287[i] <- parts[1] / (parts[1] + parts[2])
  }
  # else stays NA (strain 1, excluded)
}

# Subset to relevant rows
fitdat <- subset(dat, !is.na(prop287))
cat("\nRows for modeling:", nrow(fitdat), "\n")
cat("\nData summary:\n")
print(fitdat[, c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "prop287", "Area")])

cat("\nProportion values:\n")
print(sort(unique(fitdat$prop287)))

# Fit models
# Quadratic: Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2)
m_quad <- lm(Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2), data = fitdat)
cat("\n=== Quadratic Model ===\n")
cat("AIC:", AIC(m_quad), "\n")
cat("Coefficients:\n")
print(summary(m_quad)$coefficients)
cat("R-squared:", summary(m_quad)$r.squared, "\n")

# Cubic: Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2) + I(prop287^3)
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ prop287 + I(prop287^2) + I(prop287^3), data = fitdat)
cat("\n=== Cubic Model ===\n")
cat("AIC:", AIC(m_cubic), "\n")
cat("Coefficients:\n")
print(summary(m_cubic)$coefficients)
cat("R-squared:", summary(m_cubic)$r.squared, "\n")

# Natural spline df=4
library(splines)
m_ns <- lm(Area ~ ns(prop287, df = 4), data = fitdat)
cat("\n=== Natural Spline (df=4) Model ===\n")
cat("AIC:", AIC(m_ns), "\n")
cat("R-squared:", summary(m_ns)$r.squared, "\n")
cat("Effective df:", length(coef(m_ns)), "parameters\n")

# Compare AICs
aics <- c(Quadratic = AIC(m_quad), Cubic = AIC(m_cubic), NaturalSpline = AIC(m_ns))
cat("\n=== AIC Comparison ===\n")
print(aics)
cat("Best model (lowest AIC):", names(which.min(aics)), "\n")

# Select best model
best_name <- names(which.min(aics))
best_model <- switch(best_name,
  Quadratic = m_quad,
  Cubic = m_cubic,
  NaturalSpline = m_ns
)

# Find optimal proportion (maximizing predicted Area) within [0, 1]
# Use optimization
obj_fn <- function(p) {
  newdat <- data.frame(prop287 = p)
  -predict(best_model, newdata = newdat)
}

# Try optimize
opt <- optimize(obj_fn, interval = c(0, 1), maximum = FALSE)
cat("\n=== Optimal Proportion ===\n")
cat("Optimal p:", opt$minimum, "\n")

# Predicted Area at optimum
pred_opt <- predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = opt$minimum))
cat("Maximum predicted Area:", pred_opt, "\n")

# Also do a fine grid search as verification
pgrid <- seq(0, 1, length.out = 10001)
preds <- predict(best_model, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = pgrid))
grid_max_idx <- which.max(preds)
cat("\nGrid search verification:\n")
cat("Optimal p (grid):", pgrid[grid_max_idx], "\n")
cat("Max Area (grid):", preds[grid_max_idx], "\n")

# Plot for sanity check
pdf("model_fit.pdf", width = 10, height = 6)
plot(fitdat$prop287, fitdat$Area,
     xlab = "Proportion of strain 287",
     ylab = "Colony Area",
     main = paste("Best model:", best_name))
lines(pgrid, preds, col = "red", lwd = 2)
# Add other model predictions for comparison
preds_quad <- predict(m_quad, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = pgrid))
preds_cubic <- predict(m_cubic, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = pgrid))
preds_ns <- predict(m_ns, newdata = data.frame(prop287 = pgrid))
lines(pgrid, preds_quad, col = "blue", lwd = 1, lty = 2)
lines(pgrid, preds_cubic, col = "green", lwd = 1, lty = 3)
lines(pgrid, preds_ns, col = "orange", lwd = 1, lty = 4)
legend("topleft",
       legend = c(best_name, "Quadratic", "Cubic", "Natural Spline"),
       col = c("red", "blue", "green", "orange"),
       lty = c(1, 2, 3, 4), lwd = c(2, 1, 1, 1))
dev.off()

cat("\nDone.\n")

parameters.content:
# Read data
data <- read.csv("inputs/Swarm_2.csv")

# Parse Ratio to get proportion of strain 287
# For mixtures (287_98), ratio is like "1:3" meaning 287:98
# For pure strains, ratio is "1:0"

# Function to extract proportion of strain 287
get_prop_287 <- function(strain, ratio) {
  if (strain == "287") {
    return(1.0)  # pure 287
  } else if (strain == "98") {
    return(0.0)  # pure 98
  } else if (strain == "287_98") {
    parts <- as.numeric(strsplit(as.character(ratio), ":")[[1]])
    return(parts[1] / (parts[1] + parts[2]))
  } else {
    return(NA)  # strain 1, not relevant
  }
}

data$prop_287 <- mapply(get_prop_287, data$StrainNumber, data$Ratio)

# Filter to relevant rows (exclude strain 1)
data_sub <- subset(data, !is.na(prop_287))

cat("Data used:\n")
print(data_sub[, c("StrainNumber", "Ratio", "prop_287", "Area")])

# Fit models
# Quadratic
m_quad <- lm(Area ~ prop_287 + I(prop_287^2), data = data_sub)
# Cubic
m_cubic <- lm(Area ~ prop_287 + I(prop_287^2) + I(prop_287^3), data = data_sub)
# Natural spline with df=4
library(splines)
m_ns <- lm(Area ~ ns(prop_287, df = 4), data = data_sub)

# Compare models using AIC
aic_quad <- AIC(m_quad)
aic_cubic <- AIC(m_cubic)
aic_ns <- AIC(m_ns)

cat("\nAIC values:\n")
cat(sprintf("Quadratic: %.2f\n", aic_quad))
cat(sprintf("Cubic: %.2f\n", aic_cubic))
cat(sprintf("Natural spline (df=4): %.2f\n", aic_ns))

# Also check adjusted R-squared
adj_r2_quad <- summary(m_quad)$adj.r.squared
adj_r2_cubic <- summary(m_cubic)$adj.r.squared
adj_r2_ns <- summary(m_ns)$adj.r.squared

cat("\nAdjusted R-squared:\n")
cat(sprintf("Quadratic: %.4f\n", adj_r2_quad))
cat(sprintf("Cubic: %.4f\n", adj_r2_cubic))
cat(sprintf("Natural spline (df=4): %.4f\n", adj_r2_ns))

# Determine best model by AIC (lowest)
models <- list(quad = m_quad, cubic = m_cubic, ns = m_ns)
aics <- c(quad = aic_quad, cubic = aic_cubic, ns = aic_ns)
best_name <- names(which.min(aics))
best_model <- models[[best_name]]

cat(sprintf("\nBest model by AIC: %s\n", best_name))

# Grid search for optimal proportion
grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.0001)
pred_df <- data.frame(prop_287 = grid)
preds <- predict(best_model, newdata = pred_df)

opt_idx <- which.max(preds)
opt_prop <- grid[opt_idx]
max_area <- preds[opt_idx]

cat(sprintf("\nOptimal proportion of strain 287: %.4f\n", opt_prop))
cat(sprintf("Maximum predicted colony area: %.2f\n", max_area))

# Also check with optimize for better precision
pred_func <- function(x) {
  newdata <- data.frame(prop_287 = x)
  predict(best_model, newdata = newdata)
}

opt <- optimize(pred_func, interval = c(0, 1), maximum = TRUE)
cat(sprintf("\nOptimize result:\n"))
cat(sprintf("Optimal proportion: %.6f\n", opt$maximum))
cat(sprintf("Maximum area: %.2f\n", opt$objective))

# Write answer
dir.create("codex_output", showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines(as.character(round(opt$objective, 2)), "codex_output/answer.txt")
cat("\nAnswer written to codex_output/answer.txt\n")
